adjudication_trailer.SUMMARY: "120 strings judged: 112 pass, 8 warn, 0 fail. None critical, 1 major (27, Bundle became Package), 7 minor. Every {placeholder} and HTML tag survived. Warns: 15 and 17 (bean became task), 16 and 41 (CDN edge became node, which clashes with catalogue nodes), 19 (recorded became saved), 22 (kind became type), 27 (DSpace Bundle became Package) and 100 (interpolated became extrapolated). Seven of the eight are term drift; 19 and 100 are sense drift. Not counted as drift: 'item' coming back as 'document' throughout, since 'Document' is DSpace's standard French label for an item; 'rendered/rendering' coming back as 'generated' (a near-synonym the round trip naturally produces, and 'renderings' itself survived); 'withheld' coming back as 'not displayed'; 'under WHO' as 'under the aegis of WHO'; 'routes' as 'accesses'; 'visualiser' as 'viewer'; 'identifier lookup' as 'search by identifier'; 'live' as 'active' for rows; 'materialized' spelled 'materialised'; 'KG' expanded to 'knowledge graph'; 'Source of record' as 'Authoritative source'; 'Publication titles' shortened to 'Titles'; and changes of case, articles, word order and register. The evidence-certainty glossary terms (116-119) and WHO office and governing-body names all survived."
